export_evidence: No export record found. The only populated customs dataset (ImportKey, slug 'sagar-rubber-products-private-limited') is an India INBOUND import ledger: 'Total Shipments 1027 Records detected ... Latest Cargo 2026-02-28', with every visible row showing India as DESTINATION, e.g. '2026-02-28 | MAINLAND TRADE INITIATIVE(H.K)LTD -> SAGAR RUBBER PRODUCTS PRIVATE LIMITED | POWERED RUBBER ROLLER CONVEYOR ... | Shenzhen, CHINA -> AHEMDABAD ICD INSBI6, India | HS 84283900 | BOL 7802552'. No row with India as origin/shipper, no destination country outside India, and no HS 401490/401699 line was seen. Source counter: page claims 1027 shipments / 29 trading partners / 44 port lanes; rows actually rendered on the free view = 5 shipment rows (all imports), 5 supplier rows, 5 buyer rows, 5 port rows. Export-side sources (volza, eximpedia, trademo) returned HTTP 403 and could not be read; DuckDuckGo search backend was down (connection refused), so absence of export records is based on the readable ImportKey view only, not on an exhaustive sweep.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract or annual-report split could be retrieved: web_search returned 'no results (searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>)' on both attempts, and eximpedia/trademo/volza free views returned HTTP 403. The only domestic-side signal is the registered address on the customs record: 'PLOT NO.143 GIDC II MODHERA ROAD, DEDIYASAN' (GIDC Modhera Road industrial estate, Mehsana district, Gujarat), which indicates a manufacturing/warehouse presence but is not evidence of a supply transaction.
note: Direction of trade is the key finding: the 1027-record customs file for this entity is entirely IMPORT traffic into India (China, Belgium/Antwerp origins; rubber accelerators HS 38121000, glass vials HS 70109000, conveyor parts HS 84283900, returnable metal crates HS 73101010). That is consistent with a rubber-products manufacturer buying raw materials and packaging, but it is NOT evidence of the declared export of HS 401490/401699. No export bill of lading with date, destination and B/L number was found, so export_status = none_found rather than declared_only. Domestic supply: no GST turnover band, tender award or contract is public in the sources I could reach — recorded as unknown, not as confirmed. Note also that the buyer/supplier tables on ImportKey mix several unrelated companies into single rows (e.g. 'SAGAR RUBBER PRODUCTS PRIVATE LIMITED, JOSE RUBEN SILVA SANTANA, LINEAR PHARMA, GRAND PHARMA (PRIVATE) LIMITED'), so those counterparty counts should not be attributed to this company. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in accessible sources, not estimated. Per project rules this is a trader/manufacturer classification question, not a rejection ground; no registry or catalogue data was used.
